name: Peninsula Humane Society SPCA Low-Cost Vaccine Clinics
description: $15 vaccines and $30 microchips for dogs and cats, by appointment
fullDescription: Peninsula Humane Society & SPCA holds low-cost vaccination and microchip clinics for dogs and cats at its Coyote Point shelter in San Mateo.
whatTheyOffer:
- Vaccines for rabies, DHPP, FVRCP, and FeLV: $15 per vaccine
- Microchips: $30
- Dog and cat licenses available for purchase
- For cats and dogs of all ages
- Clinics on the 1st and 3rd Saturday (9:00-10:50 am) and 2nd Wednesday (6:00-7:50 pm) of each month
howToGetIt:
1. Check the PHS vaccination clinic page for upcoming dates
2. Register online for an appointment (appointment only; sign-ups open about 2 weeks ahead and fill quickly)
3. If the clinic is full, call 650-340-7022 ext. 332 to join the waitlist
4. Bring your pet to the Coyote Point shelter at your appointment time
keywords: Peninsula Humane Society, PHS SPCA, vaccine clinic, vaccinations, rabies, DHPP, FVRCP, FeLV, microchip, dog license, San Mateo
